_comment: LLM list prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, used by trustresume.telemetry
to turn per-run token counts into an estimated cost.
Keys are matched against the provider-reported model id: an exact match
wins, otherwise the LONGEST key that is a substring of the id wins (so
do not need their own entry.
A model with no entry here makes the whole run report cost_usd=null
rather than a partial total (see telemetry.estimate_cost). If you want a
cost figure for your provider, add its rate below.
These are public list prices; VERIFY against your provider's current
pricing page before quoting them. Bedrock/Gemini rates are intentionally
left out rather than guessed — add the rate from your own account's rate
card. Override this file's path with $TRUSTRESUME_PRICING.
